name: disable_object_damage

stack.evidence: func_001EBC10 consumes one object ID, resolves it through func_001EAB00, queues two object operations when found, and decrements Script stackTop by one

notes: func_001EBC10 queues operation types 0x24 and 0x2B for the resolved object. Both map to embedded DAMAGE_OFF entries and set the corresponding damage-disable flags. This is the explicit-object counterpart of command 336 disable_script_object_damage and the inverse of command 375 enable_object_damage. The JP corpus contains 138 calls.
